ns2:course.label: Analysis of Nonlinear Systems
ns2:course.description: Nonlinear dynamics, vector fields and flows, Lyapunov stability theory, regular and singular perturbations, averaging, integral manifolds, input-output and input-to-state stability, and various design applications in control systems and robotics. Same as GE 520 and ME 546. Prerequisite: ECE 515 and MATH 285.
